sentences.text: FDA's records show calcium gluconate is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21, and the earlier shortage first posted on 2021-03-24 has been resolved.
No public FDA signal exists at the plants for the recommended alternate manufacturer Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC was last inspected with a VAI classification on 2023-10-13, and HP Halden Pharma AS was last inspected with a VAI classification on 2023-05-10.
Corvale East holds 866 vials of the 98 mg/mL 10 mL presentation with 34.5 days on hand at 25.1 vials per day.
Corvale General holds 382 vials of the same presentation with 28.9 days on hand at 13.2 vials per day.
The next ranked alternatives are B. Braun Medical Inc. and Caplin Steriles Limited, neither of which is on FDA's shortage list today.
